id: \bHello there. I'm Mallow's brother. Nice to meet you.
en: \bHello there. I'm Mallow's brother. Nice to meet you.
it: \bCiao. Sono il fratello di Ibis. Piacere di conoscerti.

id: \bFight the power! Quit while you still can. Turn it off!
en: \bFight the power! Quit while you still can. Turn it off!
it: \bCombatti il potere! Smetti finché sei in tempo. Spegnilo!

id: \rLusamine: It's a pleasure to meet one of Lillie's friends!
en: \rLusamine: It's a pleasure to meet one of Lillie's friends!
it: \rSamina: È un piacere conoscere uno degli amici di Lylia!

id: \rI love coming here.
en: \rI love coming here.
it: \rAdoro venire qui.

id: \rLillie: \PN, this is my brother Gladion. He's not the most friendly.
en: \rLillie: \PN, this is my brother Gladion. He's not the most friendly.
it: \rLylia: \PN, lui è mio fratello Iridio. Non è il tipo più socievole.

id: \rTsareena
en: \rTsareena
it: \rTsareena

id: \rMallow: My brother came to visit! I'm so excited! Help me burn off some energy.
en: \rMallow: My brother came to visit! I'm so excited! Help me burn off some energy.
it: \rIbis: Mio fratello è venuto a trovarmi! Sono così emozionata! Aiutami a sfogare un po' di energia.

id: Rotom Dex: What a fun day. Let's head home.
en: Rotom Dex: What a fun day. Let's head home.
it: Rotom Dex: Che giornata divertente. Torniamo a casa.

id: \rMallow: I've calmed down now. Thanks \PN.
en: \rMallow: I've calmed down now. Thanks \PN.
it: \rIbis: Ora mi sono calmata. Grazie, \PN.

id: \rMallow: Hi, \PN. I just created something spicy. Care to try?
en: \rMallow: Hi, \PN. I just created something spicy. Care to try?
it: \rIbis: Ciao, \PN. Ho appena creato qualcosa di piccante. Vuoi assaggiare?

id: \rMallow: Come back soon. There will be plently of tasty dishes.
en: \rMallow: Come back soon. There will be plently of tasty dishes.
it: \rIbis: Torna presto. Ci saranno un sacco di piatti gustosi.

id: \bMohn: It's good to be back. I've missed so much.
en: \bMohn: It's good to be back. I've missed so much.
it: \bMohn: È bello essere tornato. Mi sono perso così tanto.

id: \rLillie: Thanks for coming and checking on the egg. I know it will hatch soon.
en: \rLillie: Thanks for coming and checking on the egg. I know it will hatch soon.
it: \rLylia: Grazie di essere venuto a controllare l'Uovo. Sono sicura che si schiuderà presto.

id: \rWell until then, why don't you battle my butler? He's always been very competent at it.
en: \rWell until then, why don't you battle my butler? He's always been very competent at it.
it: \rNel frattempo, perché non sfidi il mio maggiordomo? È sempre stato molto bravo a lottare.

id: \rLillie: That was a great battle.
en: \rLillie: That was a great battle.
it: \rLylia: È stata una lotta magnifica.

id: \rLillie: \PN! I'm sorry to take you away from your day with Kiawe but I had to show you something. My egg hatched. Take a look.
en: \rLillie: \PN! I'm sorry to take you away from your day with Kiawe but I had to show you something. My egg hatched. Take a look.
it: \rLylia: \PN! Scusa se ti porto via dalla tua giornata con Kiawe, ma dovevo mostrarti una cosa. Il mio Uovo si è schiuso. Guarda.

id: \rLillie: I'm so happy to have Snowy with me. Thanks for stopping by. You should go have your day with Kiawe.
en: \rLillie: I'm so happy to have Snowy with me. Thanks for stopping by. You should go have your day with Kiawe.
it: \rLylia: Sono così felice di avere Snowy con me. Grazie di essere passato. Ora dovresti andare a goderti la giornata con Kiawe.

id: \rLillie: \PN, what is that strange Pokémon? Oh right, where are my manners? This...is my mother, Lusamine.
en: \rLillie: \PN, what is that strange Pokémon? Oh right, where are my manners? This...is my mother, Lusamine.
it: \rLylia: \PN, cos'è quello strano Pokémon? Ah giusto, dove sono finite le mie buone maniere? Lei... è mia madre, Samina.

id: \rLusamine: Oh it's always nice to meet one of Lillie's friends! You're just as cute as she is!
en: \rLusamine: Oh it's always nice to meet one of Lillie's friends! You're just as cute as she is!
it: \rSamina: Oh, è sempre bello conoscere uno degli amici di Lylia! Sei carino proprio come lei!

id: \rLillie: Mother please... Anyways \PN, that Pokémon looks upset. Maybe watching a battle will cheer it up.
en: \rLillie: Mother please... Anyways \PN, that Pokémon looks upset. Maybe watching a battle will cheer it up.
it: \rLylia: Mamma, ti prego... Comunque, \PN, quel Pokémon sembra turbato. Magari guardare una lotta lo tirerà su.

id: \rLillie: It looks like Nebby calmed down. You like Nebby right? We have to call it something after all.
en: \rLillie: It looks like Nebby calmed down. You like Nebby right? We have to call it something after all.
it: \rLylia: Sembra che Nebby si sia calmato. Ti piace Nebby, vero? Dopotutto dobbiamo pur chiamarlo in qualche modo.

id: \rMaybe the professor will know what Nebby is.
en: \rMaybe the professor will know what Nebby is.
it: \rForse il professore saprà cos'è Nebby.

id: \rLillie: Maybe the professor will know what to do with Nebby.
en: \rLillie: Maybe the professor will know what to do with Nebby.
it: \rLylia: Forse il professore saprà cosa fare con Nebby.

id: \bI want to go out and play.
en: \bI want to go out and play.
it: \bVoglio uscire a giocare.

id: \rI'm Lana's sister Harper.
en: \rI'm Lana's sister Harper.
it: \rSono Harper, la sorella di Suiren.

id: \bI'm Sophocles's dad. It's always nice to meet a fellow classmate of his.
en: \bI'm Sophocles's dad. It's always nice to meet a fellow classmate of his.
it: \bSono il papà di Chrys. È sempre bello conoscere un suo compagno di classe.

id: \bWelcome to my restaurant. Feel free to try whatever you want.
en: \bWelcome to my restaurant. Feel free to try whatever you want.
it: \bBenvenuto nel mio ristorante. Assaggia pure tutto quello che vuoi.

id: \bGladion: \PN, it's nice to see you. Remember our promise to battle each other next time we met? Let's begin.
en: \bGladion: \PN, it's nice to see you. Remember our promise to battle each other next time we met? Let's begin.
it: \bIridio: \PN, è bello vederti. Ricordi la nostra promessa di sfidarci la prossima volta che ci saremmo incontrati? Cominciamo.

id: \bGladion: I'm happy my dad is back. Our family has never been better.
en: \bGladion: I'm happy my dad is back. Our family has never been better.
it: \bIridio: Sono felice che mio padre sia tornato. La nostra famiglia non è mai stata meglio.

id: This ball contain a Cosmog. Would you like to take it?
en: This ball contain a Cosmog. Would you like to take it?
it: Questa Ball contiene un Cosmog. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: \rI'm Lana's sister Sarah.
en: \rI'm Lana's sister Sarah.
it: \rSono Sarah, la sorella di Suiren.

id: \rSophocles has told us all about you.
en: \rSophocles has told us all about you.
it: \rChrys ci ha raccontato tutto di te.

id: \bGladion: \PN, is it? Lillie says you're strong. I could use a challenge. Take me on.
en: \bGladion: \PN, is it? Lillie says you're strong. I could use a challenge. Take me on.
it: \bIridio: \PN, giusto? Lylia dice che sei forte. Mi farebbe comodo una sfida. Affrontami.

id: \bGladion: Impressive. You'll become a strong ally to someone one day.
en: \bGladion: Impressive. You'll become a strong ally to someone one day.
it: \bIridio: Notevole. Un giorno diventerai un alleato potente per qualcuno.

id: Rotom Dex: Wonderful battle \PN. Let's head back to the professor.
en: Rotom Dex: Wonderful battle \PN. Let's head back to the professor.
it: Rotom Dex: Lotta splendida, \PN. Torniamo dal professore.

id: \rLillie: \PN, good to see you. Mother, brother, and I are doing so well now.
en: \rLillie: \PN, good to see you. Mother, brother, and I are doing so well now.
it: \rLylia: \PN, che bello vederti. Io, la mamma e mio fratello stiamo benissimo ora.

id: \rWould you like to battle? It's the last I can do since you came so far.
en: \rWould you like to battle? It's the last I can do since you came so far.
it: \rTi va di lottare? È il minimo che possa fare, visto che sei venuto fin qui.

id: \rLillie: Come back soon.
en: \rLillie: Come back soon.
it: \rLylia: Torna presto.

id: This ball contain a Magearna. Would you like to take it?
en: This ball contain a Magearna. Would you like to take it?
it: Questa Ball contiene un Magearna. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: \bGood day. Welcome to Miss Lusamine's home.
en: \bGood day. Welcome to Miss Lusamine's home.
it: \bBuongiorno. Benvenuto nella casa della signora Samina.

id: \bSo you want to battle me in Miss Lillie's place? Very well.
en: \bSo you want to battle me in Miss Lillie's place? Very well.
it: \bQuindi desideri sfidarmi al posto della signorina Lylia? Molto bene.

id: Rotom Dex: That seems like enough for one day. Let's head home.
en: Rotom Dex: That seems like enough for one day. Let's head home.
it: Rotom Dex: Per oggi direi che basta. Torniamo a casa.

id: \bI'd recommend the soup.
en: \bI'd recommend the soup.
it: \bVi consiglio la zuppa.

id: \bSophocles: There you are. I need someone to practice battling on and you seem like the best pick.
en: \bSophocles: There you are. I need someone to practice battling on and you seem like the best pick.
it: \bChrys: Eccoti. Mi serve qualcuno con cui esercitarmi nelle lotte e tu mi sembri la scelta migliore.

id: Rotom Dex: Let's head back home.
en: Rotom Dex: Let's head back home.
it: Rotom Dex: Torniamo a casa.

id: \bSophocles: Thanks for the help.
en: \bSophocles: Thanks for the help.
it: \bChrys: Grazie per l'aiuto.

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
